name: @sabeel/media-copier
description: Cloudflare Worker that copies a Zoom recording file into the R2 media bucket

scripts.bucket-config: wrangler r2 bucket cors set oursabeel-lms-media --file ../media-bucket/cors.json --force && wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set oursabeel-lms-media --file ../media-bucket/lifecycle.json --force
